about: sha256 pins of the DeepSeek-200 live signal code (paper v4, group ds200; paperbot/dssig.py checks them before it loads lib_c). lib_c.py must also equal research/deepseek200/out/summary.json code_sha256['lib_c.py'] (the 5-year run's own pin) and PREREG_DEEPSEEK200.md must equal PREREG_DEEPSEEK200.sha256. summary.json pins only lib_c.py, so the library and vendor files lib_c imports are pinned here. Part of the DS hash set: a change here restarts the DeepSeek window only. Never edit during the run.
